text:
ryan_cs: Heads up — Vendor LuminaHealth sent their vendor risk form for the upcoming renewal. Lots of SOC2 scope / KMS / embeddings retention questions. We have 4 business days to return.

emily_security: On it. Do we know whether they expect customer-managed keys or just confirmation of our attestations?

ryan_cs: They asked specifically about CMKs, whether embeddings are persisted, and where audit logs live. Also a question about data deletion SLA.

anna_engineer: Quick technical: hosted API does NOT persist embeddings by default — we keep transient KV cache and request logs for telemetry. Persistent storage is only when a customer opts into archived embeddings (Dedicated/private).

emily_security: For encryption: data in transit and at rest are encrypted. Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys; Private deployments support customer-managed CMKs (KMS/HSM). I'll paste the summary to use in the form:

```
KMS support summary:
- Hosted: Redwood-managed keys (rotated monthly).
- Dedicated/Private: Customer-managed CMKs supported (bring-your-own KMS/HSM).
- Access to key material is restricted; key rotation and audit logs available to tenant admins in Private.
```

julie_onboarding: I'll draft the vendor form answers. Need the exact retention numbers for logs and embeddings so we can be precise.

anna_engineer: Logs: default retention = 90 days; enterprise retention option = 365 days (requires contract addendum). Embeddings: default retention = 0 days (not persisted). If customer enables archived embeddings in Dedicated/Private, retention is per their bucket lifecycle (we recommend 90/365 options). Note: enabling persistence affects billing.

sara_legal: From legal: include line "subject to our DPA and SOC2 attestation" and ask vendor to confirm whether they require a DPA before we return the form. If they insist on CMK for hosted, that's a material change — escalate to contracts.

marco_sales: FYI — if LuminaHealth requires CMK on Hosted or unusually long retention windows, this will likely trigger a commercial review (possible pricing/contract adjustments). Marking as potential renewal risk.

ops_bot: Created ticket #CS-3247 and attached LuminaHealth_questionnaire.pdf. Deadline: 4 business days.

ryan_cs: Great — I'll consolidate answers and post a draft reply by EOD tomorrow. Please DM me if you want to edit wording. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
